text_block_list.text: (WHAAAAAMMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what!? Palmer-san's going crazy 
fast...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well? Hitting the driving range is a 
pretty great way to unwind, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, seems like it'd train my core too! 
And besides...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing! Hitting the ball that far. 
Is that what you call the fruit of your 
practice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks! But you know, it's only 
lately that I've been able to fly that 
far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why? I haven't changed my gear, 
and I spend more time practicing with 
Trainer— and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Good core strength"? Well, I do play 
golf, so... maybe that makes sense?
choice_data_list: Let's use that to stabilize your form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So by doing that, you can run 
more smoothly... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Love it! I was actually thinking about 
that lately~ Like, the second half feels 
so sluggish and totally kills the vibe!"
choice_data_list: Let's learn to enjoy races even more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—And you put together the perfect routine 
for me, taking all my strengths and quirks 
into account, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And what's more... it's not just about 
theories and logic—they really considered 
my feelings and made a plan around that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can keep doing my best. 
...Yeah, maybe I really am growing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It hones my strengths and boosts my 
motivation. It's such a great environment. 
...Besides—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you realize? You're totally 
bragging about them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Bragging about your lover?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, is that what you mean!? No, that's 
not it! It's just a fact that my Trainer 
is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's just that your presence, Trainer, 
means so, so much to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, does phrasing it like that sound 
like bragging too? Well, whatever, who 
cares!"
